top_signals.title: Treasuries Stabilize After Slump, Stocks Decline: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Bond investors got a respite from a bruising selloff after surging oil prices and mounting bets on further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes drove Treasury yields to multi-year highs. Asian stocks fell.
